subject: Renewal forecast tidy: hygiene checklist & weak-signal escalation
messages:
From: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@brightwave.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procureops@brightwave.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal forecast tidy: hygiene checklist & weak-signal escalation

Hi Laura,

Quick one as we prep for our renewal in mid-August — finance is asking us to confirm the ARR numbers and call out any area where usage dropped below expectations. I pulled a quick usage report and noticed a 23% dip in token consumption for our main inference route in June vs. April.

Can you confirm whether that aligns with your telemetry and whether we should expect baseline ARR to change? Also: procurement wants a minimal evidence pack (SOC 2 screenshots, retention policy confirmation) to unblock internal approvals.

We want to keep this on the normal renewals cadence if possible, but if the usage trend signals churn risk we may need to re-evaluate the timeline.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call.

Emma Lawson
Account Lead, BrightWave
emma.lawson@brightwave.com
+1 415-555-0142

Attachments: (none)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@brightwave.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal forecast tidy: hygiene checklist & weak-signal escalation

Emma — thanks for the heads up and the data. I pulled the same telemetry and see the drop concentrated in two microservices (batch ingestion for analytic prompts + a drop in recurring scheduled jobs). Early read is configuration change on their side + a smaller number of active sessions.

Plan:
- Naomi will assemble the SOC2 + retention evidence pack for procurement.
- Ben will run a quick usage-delta analysis and provide a short summary that maps to ARR exposure.
- I will confirm renewal timelines and advise if this becomes a churn-risk scenario.

Can you confirm the procurement cutover date (when they need evidence by)? If it's before 24 Jul we should prioritize the evidence pack. If it's later we can include the usage analysis and a recommended path (conservative renewal vs. scoped discount).

I'll follow up with a one-pager and a suggested MAPl (mutual action plan) for the renewal next week.

— Laura Bennett
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal forecast tidy: hygiene checklist & weak-signal escalation

Quick findings (attached summary):
- 23% drop is correct when comparing April -> June for the inference.prod route.
- Root cause: three scheduled workflows were disabled mid-May after a partner update; combined they represented ~12% of total tokens.
- Remaining delta appears to be lower active sessions from two internal teams (likely a product toggle).

Impact on ARR: current committed ARR unchanged; however if the scheduled workflows are permanently disabled we model ~8% ARR degradation at renewal time for that route (low-medium risk).

Attachments: usage-delta-analysis.pdf (summary chart + conservative ARR mapping)

I'll add a short appendix with cohort IDs so their engineers can validate.

— Ben Carter
Account Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@brightwave.com>
Cc: procureops@brightwave.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal forecast tidy: hygiene checklist & weak-signal escalation

Emma — attaching the evidence pack and a short usage summary for your procurement and finance teams. TL;DR: committed ARR is intact on our books; we surface a low-medium risk if scheduled workflows remain disabled. Recommended next steps:

1) Procurement: confirm receipt of the evidence pack (SOC2s, retention policy screenshot, audit-log sample). If you need the HSM/KMS attestation I can request it from security but that will add ~3 business days.
2) Ops validation: Ben included cohort IDs — please have BrightWave engineering confirm whether the scheduled workflows were intentionally retired. If yes, we can draft a scoped amendment mapping the reduced usage to a route-level commit change.
3) Renewal timing: recommend keeping the mid-August renewal date but include an item in the MAPl to revisit ARR if the workflows are not re-enabled within 30 days post-renewal.

I can join a 20-min call next Tue (23 Jul) at 10am PT if that helps align procurement + engineering. Let me know.

Attachments: renewal-evidence-pack.zip, usage-delta-analysis.pdf

Best,
